alive.last_commit_message:
fix(yamlcheck): deduplicate severity labels in isValidSeverity (#714)

Fix a Go compile error in cmd/yamlcheck/main.go where isValidSeverity declared duplicate constant case labels: the Chinese severities (信息/低/中/中危/高/高危/严重/危急) and "unknown" appeared both in the combined first case line and again as standalone case blocks. Go rejects duplicate case labels, which broke  on main (and therefore the repo-wide Build and test Go packages CI job, causing unrelated PRs such as #711 to show a red build).

The fix removes the duplicate Chinese alias case blocks and folds 信息 into the single combined case line; the effective accepted severity allow-list is unchanged.

Local verification (isolated checkout of head f74071c):
- go build ./cmd/yamlcheck -> success.
- go vet ./cmd/yamlcheck -> clean.
This restores the broken main build for the yamlcheck command.

Co-authored-by: wjl8636 <wjl8636@users.noreply.github.com>
